about.mission: Talk That Science exists to drag brilliant, under-heard research out of journals and into rooms full of curious, slightly tipsy people. Every episode and every bar night pairs one host, one or two researchers, and a live audience that's allowed — encouraged, even — to ask the questions journal peer review never will.
about.story: What started as a monthly slot on Echobox Radio turned into a live event series at Oedipus Brewery: same mix of good music and real science, just with beer and a room full of neighbours. This site is the front door to both — stream the show, catch up on past episodes, see what's coming up, and grab the slides if you were in the room (or wish you had been).
